comment: The baguette was still warm when I got home. Great crust and soft inside.
I bought a bagette this morning and it tasted a little stale.
Love the traditional baguette, although the line was pretty long.
The BAGUETTE was delicious but it was smaller than I expected for the price.
The demi baguet is perfect for lunch. I wish you had more in stock.
The croissants were light, buttery, and flaky. Probably my favorite item here.
My croisant was dry and seemed like it had been sitting out all morning.
I usually love the croissants, but todays batch was underbaked in the middle.
The almond croissant had great flavor, but it was way too sweet for me.
The croissant amandes was amazing. Plenty of almond filling without being soggy.
The brioche was soft and fresh. We finished the whole loaf that afternoon.
Brioche tasted good, but the price felt a little high.
My briosh was dense and not nearly as fluffy as I expected.
The brioch is consistently excellent. I buy one every weekend.
The pain au chocolat had a generous amount of chocolate and a crispy outside.
My pan au chocolat was cold and the chocolate tasted a little bitter.
Really liked the pain au chocolat, but there was barely any chocolate inside.
The chocolate almond pastry was excellent. I liked it more than the regular one.
The kouign amann was caramelized perfectly, with a crisp edge and buttery center.
My kouin aman was burned on the bottom and unpleasantly bitter.
The kouign-amann was tasty, but it felt a little greasy.
The eclair filling was smooth and the chocolate topping was delicious.
The eclaire looked beautiful but the pastry tasted soggy.
The chocolate eclair was pretty good, although the filling was overly sweet.
The apple turnover was fresh and had a nice balance of apple and cinnamon.
The cookies were tasty but a bit too hard around the edges.
The cashier was incredibly helpful and patient while I decided what to order.
The checkout line was slow and the tables had not been cleaned.
Friendly staff, but my order took almost twenty minutes.
Everything was terrible. Five stars because I accidentally clicked the wrong rating.
The sandwich meal deal was convenient and filling for lunch.
The sandwich complet was bland, and the bread was much too dry.
The financier box was nice, but I could not find prices clearly displayed.
The seigle bread was hearty and stayed fresh for a couple of days.
